negative_controls: positive post-cutoff access without a verified zero-match query remains unknown
zero-match query range must equal (coverage-start sequence, first-access sequence minus one]
decision-boundary checkpoint must be strictly later than latest possible decision cutoff
coverage-start checkpoint must be no later than earliest possible decision cutoff
first access event sequence must be greater than decision-boundary checkpoint sequence
first access sequence must be exactly one greater than zero-match query's upper sequence
first access event sequence must be no greater than coverage-end checkpoint sequence
first access event and all checkpoints must use the same ledger, namespace and epoch
nonzero sequence gap, unresolved outage, backfill, policy change or known bypass prevents complete status
RFC9162_SHA256 consistency receipt must not be treated as a non-inclusion proof
